facts.statement: Paying members in good standing (or those who registered before the deadline) received a Snow Days reward pack, delivered starting noon 16 December, taking two to three days to reach every account.
facts.quote: Tomará dos a tres días para que los regalos lleguen a cada cuenta

article_summaries.title: Premios para Miembros de Días de Nieve (Free Realms - What is New?, Spanish-language post)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language SOE news post announcing the Snow Days member gift. Paying members in good standing (or those who registered before the deadline) would receive a reward pack at noon on Wednesday 15 December, delivered 16 December over two to three days, with the contents scaling by membership plan length. The page shows no year; the post's relative date (5 months, 3 weeks ago, at a 2011-06-04 capture) suggests late 2010, but this is inferred, so the date is left null.
